component.name: ShareX
component.summary: Screen capture, file sharing and productivity tool

p.em: Note: This is an unofficial, community-driven Linux port of ShareX by jocost4. Upstream ShareX is originally created and maintained by the ShareX Team (Jaex).

description.p: ShareX is a free and open source program that lets you capture or record any area of your screen and share it with a single press of a key. It also allows uploading images, text or other types of files to many supported destinations you can choose from.

ul.li: Fullscreen, active window, and active monitor
Interactive rectangular region, region light, and region transparent
Screen recording and animated GIF capture
Offline text recognition (OCR) with multilingual PaddleOCR ONNX models

description.p: After capture automation and annotation tools:

ul.li: Advanced image annotator with arrows, rectangles, speech balloons, blur, pixelate, and text tools
Image effects, watermarks, filters, and color adjustments
Automatic upload to over 80 image, text, and file hosting destinations
URL shorteners and automatic QR code generation
Built-in productivity tools: color picker, screen color picker, ruler, image combiner, hash check, and directory indexer
Native Linux desktop integration supporting Wayland and X11 through modern XDG Desktop Portals and Avalonia UI

description.p: Updated with upstream ShareX v22.4.0 features and Linux fixes:

ul.li: Offline PaddleOCR ONNX engine support for multilingual text recognition
Real-time region capture coordinate & size indicator
Automatic cleanup of portal screenshot temporary files in user pictures
Support for Wayland and X11 desktop environments via XDG Desktop Portals

description.p: Initial Linux port powered by Avalonia UI and .NET 10.
